Detailed 128px sprite aesthetic, not smooth painting, not coarse polygons, not photorealism, no dithering or noisy speckles. Light from upper-left. Every limb fully visible within ample padding. Coarse brown and charcoal layers, ragged uneven shawl, long muddy skirt, broad bare feet and long toes. Clearly elderly and unsettling, not youthful. No staff or weapons.
